lines.text: I carefully open the door to the nurse's office.
The lights are off, and a cold chill lingers in the air.
and find Privaty sleeping on the innermost bed.
I sit on the edge of the bed and quietly look at her.
I reach out and brush aside her bangs,
I've been looking at you the entire time we've been at this school.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I wanted you to keep looking at me more... even more.
As I stroke her hair, Privaty reaches out and grabs my arm.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Your arm is so warm... and firm.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: This is all so real... too real to be a dream...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: This was a d-dream! It was definitely all just a dream!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Then why didn't you say so sooner?!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I-I got the wrong idea all by myself!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You're being so formal with me...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I thought it was a dream.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I guess I slept through the final bell.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Even so, you didn't have to come all the way here.
You really were exhausted, weren't you?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: but since you caught me sleeping here, I can't deny it.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Yes, I haven't been sleeping well lately.
Privaty looks at me with a slightly resentful gaze.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I said I wanted you to have fond memories of your school days.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's why I got everyone together to hang out, hoping you'd grow closer to them...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: But I ended up getting jealous.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Students who would normally be nothing but sweet and adorable...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Just seeing them sticking so close to you...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: For some reason, it made me resent them... and envy them too.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I kept wondering, if I were a student, would I be able to stand by your side like they do?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Even though it's not my place.
You lost sleep over something like that?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: What do you mean "something like that?"

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You're making my worries sound trivial.
Privaty looks at me with a puzzled expression.
There's no need to be jealous.
I don't hold my friends' hands like this.
I wouldn't even think about leaning in this close to them.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Do you see me differently from the other students?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Is it all right if I think that?
Privaty lowers her head and slowly fiddles with my hand, just like before.
Instead of refusing like I expected,
Privaty slightly lifts her head and looks up at me.
In the dim nurse's office, there are only the sounds of our conscious breathing,
the sound of our hands brushing against each other,
and occasionally the sound of rustling fabric.
It's nice to have some peace and quiet.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Next time, I'll take you to a quiet place that I know.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: and there's not a single soul there.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I guess so... I think it hit me all at once now that I'm not so tensed.
Lie down. I'll put you sleep.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It's late, and you should probably be heading back—
I grab Privaty's shoulders and lay her down on the bed.
Since you finally have the chance, just get some good rest.
I cover Privaty with a blanket,
and gently pat her on the shoulder.
For a moment, Privaty struggles to stay awake,
Now that she's sleeping, I should leave.
As I try to get up,
Privaty turns and burrows her head against me.
Unsure how to position myself, I eventually relaxed.
As I watch Privaty sleeping deeply in my arms, I eventually drift off as well.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text:
Hello, everyone.
A very good morning to you!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right everyone, turn in yesterday's homework first!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ein, don't just stand there. Take your seat.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: The bell rang literally a second ago.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: How is it that you're coming into class a second earlier every day?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: At this rate, you'll come in before the bell tomorrow.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Arcana, Amy, please return to your seats as well.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Did something happen to Miss Privaty or something?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: She's been in such a good mood these past few days.
Everyone quickly returns to their seats.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Let's keep the energy up and start today's lesson!
I guess it can't be helped. I'll have to spend some time with you tomorrow.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Anyway, what I meant was that being a teacher has given me a lot to think about.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Come on, I've slept enough. Let's head back.
Privaty stands up, brushing off her clothes.
After that, we both return to our respective dorm rooms.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Doesn't Miss Privaty seem a bit calmer to you?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: It was kinda fun watching her emotions swing all over the place before

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: but it feels like she's been a lot calmer lately.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Well, maybe it's just my imagination.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Why'd you turn into a statue all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You don't have to force yourself to say something just to comfort me.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I've had thoughts unbecoming of a teacher. That much is true.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: But I feel a lot better after getting some sleep.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... I liked that you held my hand, too.
Privaty's hand, which I'm still holding, twitches slightly.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I should get more rest back at the dorm.
Privaty stands up, brushing off her clothes.
After that, we both return to our respective dorm rooms.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Doesn't Miss Privaty seem more relaxed to you?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Miss Privaty's seemed a bit on edge lately.
